Have you had chronic pain over 6 months & seen at least 3 doctors or therapists without pain relief?
Or are you a non-surgical pain specialist who wants to help people get permanent pain relief?

Good, stay awhile. 

CHRONIC PAIN SUFFERERS ... Dr. Chris Stepien is the founder of Barefoot Rehab in Denville, NJ (45 minutes from New York City), where we fix people's annoying, frustrating pains when it's been over 6 months & they've seen 3-5 other doctors. We specialize in removing the most common cause of chronic pain in 30-60 year olds that 9 out of 10 of our patients have never heard of. ADHESION.  

And we see patients who fly in from all over the world. 

FRUSTRATED CHIROS, PTS, MASSAGE THERAPISTS, OSTEOPATHS ... Dr. Chris founded our signature non-surgical chronic pain system, Adhesion Release Methods. This is the ONLY diagnostic & treatment system helping non-surgical pain doctors & therapists become world-class at fixing adhesion to 2x their income with 50% less work in 6 months.
